items.claim: prefDisplayBounds reads direction from rounded values
union field reads as UNSEEN when another variant reaches it through a list
items.note: The variant that can't be seen into now stands as a placeholder leaf (`UNSEEN_LEAF`) that no reader judges, so `checkPrefCondition` stays silent for it. Before, that variant dropped out, and the condition check would have flagged values the other variant can hold. A test in `packages/prefs/src/condition.test.ts` guards this.

items.claim: prefReader takes the first prefix key over an exact section key
prefObjectBase calls `fromScalar(undefined)` when nothing is held
assignPrefValueAt / nestPrefValues throws through a primitive branch
repairPrefValue skips a dotted object field stored nested
prefStatusAt takes a prefix sibling over the exact dotted key
items.note: This is the same mistake as the prefReader finding, at a different site. No other first-prefix walks are left in the package.

items.claim: PrefValueOf types a clearable number as `number`
items.note: `pref.number` now returns a non-clearable leaf, the way `pref.enum` already does, so built schemas keep `number`. The ui kit-settings `ms`/`px` helpers no longer widen their return to `PrefNumber`. With the widened type they would have read as `number | undefined`.
